pageDescription: Complete breakdown of all skills and question task types for IELTS and PTE exams

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.description: Talk in English with an interviewer using your voice

topics.name: Introduction
topics.simpleDescription: Answer basic personal questions about yourself, your hobbies, and hometown

topics.name: Speaking Part 2 (Cue Card)
topics.simpleDescription: Speak for 2 minutes on a given topic after 1 minute of preparation

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: Write clear essays and describe charts in English

topics.name: Describe the figure
topics.simpleDescription: Explain a chart, graph, map, or diagram in at least 150 words

topics.name: Opinion / Agree or Disagree
topics.simpleDescription: Write a 250-word essay stating your point of view on a topic

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: Read long stories/articles and answer questions about them

topics.name: Answer according to paragraph
topics.simpleDescription: Find specific facts inside the reading text to answer questions

topics.name: Find out the writer
topics.simpleDescription: Match opinions and statements with the people who said them

topics.name: Topic of the paragraph
topics.simpleDescription: Choose the best title or main idea for each paragraph

topics.name: True / False / Not Given
topics.simpleDescription: Decide if statements match the facts, disagree, or are missing from the text

topics.name: Fill in the blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Put missing words into a summary using words from the story

listening.title: Listening
listening.description: Listen to audio recordings and answer questions

topics.name: Fill in the blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Type the missing words you hear in the voice recording

topics.name: Choose the correct answer
topics.simpleDescription: Pick the right multiple choice option from what you hear

topics.name: Navigating according to audio
topics.simpleDescription: Follow directions on a map or plan as the speaker guides you

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.description: Speak into the computer microphone to test pronunciation and fluency

topics.name: Read Aloud
topics.simpleDescription: Read a short paragraph shown on screen out loud clearly

topics.name: Repeat Sentence
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a sentence and repeat it word for word

topics.name: Describe Image
topics.simpleDescription: Look at a picture or chart and talk about it for 40 seconds

topics.name: Re-tell Lecture
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a talk and summarize it in your own words

topics.name: Answer Short Question
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a simple question and give a one-word answer

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: Write summaries and essays on the computer

topics.name: Summarize Written Text
topics.simpleDescription: Read a passage and write a one-sentence summary

topics.name: Write Essay
topics.simpleDescription: Write a 200-300 word essay about a given question

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: Read paragraphs and solve word puzzles and questions

topics.name: Reading & Writing: Fill in the Blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Pick the best word from drop-down menus to complete sentences

topics.name: Multiple Choice, Single Answer
topics.simpleDescription: Read a text and choose the single best answer

topics.name: Multiple Choice, Multiple Answers
topics.simpleDescription: Read a text and check all correct answers

topics.name: Re-order Paragraphs
topics.simpleDescription: Drag and drop shuffled sentences into the right story order

topics.name: Reading: Fill in the Blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Drag words into empty slots inside a paragraph

listening.title: Listening
listening.description: Listen to audio clips and complete various listening tasks

topics.name: Summarize Spoken Text
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a talk and write a 50-70 word summary

topics.name: Multiple Choice, Multiple Answers
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a talk and select all correct choices

topics.name: Fill in the Blanks
topics.simpleDescription: Type the missing words into sentences while listening

topics.name: Highlight Correct Summary
topics.simpleDescription: Choose the summary paragraph that best matches the audio

topics.name: Select Missing Word
topics.simpleDescription: Guess the beeped-out final word of a spoken sentence

topics.name: Write from Dictation
topics.simpleDescription: Listen to a sentence and type every word you heard accurately
